default.description: For virtual terminals, 'linux' is used. For generic terminals, 'vt100' is default.
systemd's default shell (used if LOGIN is not set in /etc/default/getty)
No default options are hardcoded — agetty defaults are applied unless overridden.
Default fallback baud rate when no --keep-baud or BREAK-based switching succeeds.
When true, skip START_DELAY. Note: systemd uses StartLimitIntervalSec/StartLimitBurst for rate-limiting, not agetty itself.
Seconds to wait before starting getty on serial ports (agetty uses --delay for per-line delay; this is used only in template expansion for systemd unit override context).
List of extra TTY device names (e.g., 'tty4') where agetty should be started beyond the systemd defaults. Note: systemd already manages tty1–tty6 by default.
Locale for TERM and environment. Note: agetty does not directly accept locale options — LANG/TERM are inherited or set in /etc/default/getty.
Username to auto-login. Requires systemd credential 'agetty.autologin' or --autologin in unit override.
